pages.text: A Switchgleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a purple-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When activated, a Switchgleam will swap the positions of you and the entity you're looking at, at the cost of one point of charge.$(br2)While held, Endermen within 10
blocks will have their teleportation attempts absorbed.$(br2)To recharge a dun Switchgleam, allow it to absorb Enderman teleportation. Each teleport attempt absorbed restores three points of charge.
$(bold)Gemcutter recipe$()$(br2)1 × arcanearchives:shaped_quartz$(br)4 × minecraft:purple_dye$(br)1 × minecraft:tripwire_hook$(br)1 × minecraft:ender_pearl$(br2)Output: 1 × arcanearchives:switchgleam
